newsitem.title: JAPAN: Dollar seen mixed, mark down on French vote.
newsitem.headline: Dollar seen mixed, mark down on French vote.

text.p: The dollar is expected to be top-heavy against yen above 116.50 yen with steady exporter offers during Asian trade on Monday, while it is likely to edge up against the mark on the French poll results, dealers said.

Mark sales are expected against the yen and the dollar on expectations of a weak euro following Sunday's triumph by France's Socialist-led opposition, which favors a less stringent interpretation of the Maastricht Treaty.
Dealers added that they would closely watch moves in mark-related trade.
